messages:
nina.partners: Heads-up team: MediqX just went live on the GCP Marketplace with a co-branded tile and a short case note. Listing includes a 3-month trial and a recommended reserved configuration for Dedicated. https://console.cloud.google.com/marketplace/details/mediqx
marketplace-bot: Marketplace tile published by nina.partners at 2026-03-22T14:40:10Z
hao.sales: That's a solid strategic account. They committed to a 12-month reserved pool + private deployment for PHI workloads. Can we please get updated logos and a legal-approved quote?
lucas.prod: Great news. They validated our cold-start latency under 50ms at 2k RPS using the new quantized model profile. Suggest we capture the perf graph and the autoscale settings for the case note (min=2, target=80% GPU util, max=20).
tara.marketing: I'll draft a marketplace banner + 2-paragraph case note. @jena.support can you share the condensed onboarding checklist and the specific SSO instructions they needed (GCP IAP + SAML)?
jena.support: Yep — will drop the onboarding checklist and a 1-page SSO snippet by lunchtime. Also adding a short troubleshooting section about model shard reassignment we had to do during setup.
nina.partners: Fingers crossed we'll get a customer quote about reduced inference cost. If we get permission for the % we'd include it on the tile. For now use the safe quote: "MediqX migrated critical NLP inference to Redwood with predictable latency and enterprise controls."
hao.sales: Noted. I'll loop in finance for marketplace revenue recognition nuances and the reserved contract. Also tagging the renewals playbook for a reference entry.
tara.marketing: Plan: marketplace tile live today, full blog post + customer Q&A next week, short demo clip (45s) for the tile. Scheduling a sync with MediqX on Thu for quote approval.
lucas.prod: FYI their infra lead asked for a sample KV cache failover snippet. I'll add a small code block to the runbook: 
```
# KV cache migration snippet
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/cache/migrate" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"source_region":"us-central1","target_region":"europe-west1"}'
```
jena.support: Added that to the runbook and noted a gotcha for cross-region key rotation.
hao.sales: Awesome cross-functional work. This will be great for the healthcare vertical marketing pack.
tara.marketing: Will update the product one-pager and add a short blurb to the healthcare solution PDF.
nina.partners: Thanks everyone. Please react with :white_check_mark: once your item is uploaded to the launch drive so I can close the task.
